title: 50-column Dummy-SWAP–MODFLOW6 strip
purpose: Isolate 50x1 MultiSWAP–MODFLOW6 topology, MODFLOW response, ownership, transactions and mass closure from Richards execution. This harness reuses the already defined F-GC49C application service and the DSW analytical response families; it adds no production interface or semantics.

ownership_contract.dummy_state: One linear top-system storage state per 1 m2 column, physically above the fixed interface z=-2 m; owner Dummy-SWAP participant.
ownership_contract.modflow_state: Confined aquifer from z=-2 m to -10 m; experimental independent physical storage owned by MODFLOW, separate from the top-system dummy volume. This explicit research domain partition does not amend the canonical production contract.
ownership_contract.interface_head: MODFLOW head at the fixed plane z=-2 m; distinct from the dummy internal/phreatic head when finite resistance is active.
ownership_contract.interface_flux: q_swap > 0 from Dummy-SWAP into MODFLOW; MODFLOW source is +q_swap, action/reaction pair counted once.
ownership_contract.storage_coefficients: Dummy S=0.05 m3/m2/m; confined aquifer Ss=0.025 1/m over 8 m gives 0.2 m3/m2/m. The two owners occupy disjoint vertical control volumes.
ownership_contract.drain_owner: MODFLOW DRN_LEFT only; Dummy-SWAP has no drainage.
ownership_contract.other_external_fluxes: uniform specified recharge into Dummy-SWAP; no ET or side/bottom flow.
ownership_contract.complete_balance: P - dS_dummy - dS_modflow - V_drain - R = 0; interface exchange is internal and excluded from the complete-domain external ledger. R is signed residual.

E_finite_resistance.zero_resistance_limit: increase conductance and verify interface/internal head gap tends to zero while mass closure holds

acceptance.hydrostatic: all 50 identical heads; zero forcing/interface/drain; zero state drift; no publication-count mismatch; fresh-process replay byte-identical
acceptance.dynamic: published positive interface exchange; lateral head gradient toward right no-flow side; left drain volume > 0 during recession; storage evolves; per-window and cumulative full-domain mass close
acceptance.numerical: MODFLOW subsystem convergence, coupling flux residual and physical mass residual recorded and judged separately; coupling flux tolerance 1e-10 m/s for this analytical screening, not production policy
acceptance.mass: absolute residual <= 1e-10 m3 per window and cumulatively; relative residual <= 1e-8 of cumulative input when input > 0

evidence_reuse.n_to_1_aggregation: DSW16 at the same head; current phase intentionally uses 1:1 only

claim_ceiling: This experiment can discriminate the F-GC application service plus MODFLOW path from the real SWAP response. The Python dummy is not a production backend and success alone does not qualify canonical coupling or the physical domain parameterization.
